blogs.title: From Rhabdo to Rheumatology: Differentiating Toxic Myopathy from Immune-Mediated Necrotising Myopathy
blogs.description: A practical breakdown of how to distinguish drug-induced rhabdomyolysis from IMNM using CK trajectories, timelines, and response to drug withdrawal versus immunosuppression. This post will use the contrast between the previously reported tirzepatide rhabdomyolysis case and this semaglutide-associated IMNM case to illustrate key clinical reasoning principles when evaluating elevated CK in patients on GLP-1 agonists.

blogs.title: Ozempic's Hidden Muscle Risk: The Emerging Spectrum of GLP-1 Agonist Myotoxicity
blogs.description: An exploration of the growing evidence for muscle-related adverse effects with GLP-1 receptor agonists—from the well-described sarcopenia and muscle mass loss to rare cases of rhabdomyolysis and now this first reported case of probable immune-mediated necrotising myopathy. With millions now prescribed these medications, this post discusses what clinicians should watch for and how pharmacovigilance will be critical in defining the true spectrum of myotoxicity.

blogs.title: The Antibody-Negative Necrotising Myopathy: Diagnostic Pitfalls and Lessons from Statin-Associated IMNM
blogs.description: A deep dive into the approximately one-third of IMNM patients who are seronegative for anti-HMGCR and anti-SRP antibodies. This post draws parallels to how statin-associated autoimmune myopathy was discovered—initially classified as toxic myopathy before the HMGCR antibody was identified—and discusses how similar discoveries may await with other drug triggers. Practical guidance on when to pursue muscle biopsy and how to make the diagnosis in antibody-negative patients.

blogs.title: Beyond the Muscle: Cardiac Involvement in Inflammatory Myopathies
blogs.description: This case featured troponin elevation, markedly elevated proBNP, and cardiac MRI findings concerning for myocarditis—yet the patient's cardiac function normalized with immunosuppression. This post reviews the spectrum of cardiac involvement in IMNM and other inflammatory myopathies, discusses when to suspect myocarditis versus stress-induced cardiomyopathy, and provides a practical approach to cardiac screening in patients presenting with inflammatory myopathy.

blogs.title: One Dose, One Diagnosis: Assessing Causality in Suspected Drug-Induced Autoimmune Disease
blogs.description: A discussion of the WHO-Uppsala Monitoring Centre causality criteria used to assess this case, and the broader challenges of attributing autoimmune disease to drug exposure. This post explores why rechallenge is often unethical in suspected drug-induced autoimmune conditions, the concept of 'triggering' versus 'causing' autoimmunity, and how clinicians can contribute to pharmacovigilance when encountering potential novel drug adverse effects.
